source: Thompson et al. 2011, Journal of Systematic Palaeontology 10, Fig. 1A: one of four earlier ankylosaur phylogenies redrawn for comparison; slanted (diagonal) cladogram, root at the left, thick lines, short ticks for sister taxa, three clade numbers. Panels B-D (the other published hypotheses) are excluded. Image: census 2 figure (995x1217 px), the embedded raster.
region_note: panel A (top left); B-D are other hypotheses
license: unverified: no licence statement in the text held
names_note: no matrix held; list = the printed tip names of panel A (genus only)
gold_note: Ankylosaur slanted cladogram, panel A, read from 4x crops, fully resolved. Sister taxa are drawn as short ticks off a longer line, each at its own point, so each comb is a ladder: (Pawpawsaurus, (Sauropelta, (Edmontonia, Panoplosaurus))), (Mymoorapelta, (Polacanthus, Gastonia)). The numbers 1-3 mark clades keyed in the caption, not names. 16 tips, fully resolved. Sample 5 case (census 2, seed 20261215). Topology transcribed from the figure image and checked node by node; topology only.
